title: Wiktionary page, uniform tree
description: One page of a Wiktionary as one JSONL line in the uniform tree (doc/uniform-tree.md): languages, entries (one per part of speech and group), senses; translations and relations under their entry. Empty fields and empty or default values are left out.

lemma.description: The form of a page of a reconstructed word, as etymology chains write it: Reconstruction:Proto-Germanic/watōr -> *watōr (its language the proto-language, gem-pro)

ns.description: Namespace number of the page: 0 main, 110 Thesaurus in en…

source.description: Where the page is in the dump: [start of its bz2 block (multistream index offset), number of the page in that block]; null for samples

text_map.description: Sections as raw wikitext by their English name (wiktsections.sqlite), or as written when the name is not known

code.description: Canonical code (wiktlangs.sqlite), null when not known

language.description: Language as written in the heading or marker (język polski, {{langue|fr}}, Ingiliffaa)

native.description: The section is in the wiki's own language

pronunciation.description: Raw wikitext of the pronunciation (IPA, audio, hyphenation) of the whole language section, when the wiki gives it there (en ===Pronunciation=== before ===Etymology 1===, pl {{wymowa}} lines without a sense id)

etymology.description: Raw wikitext of the etymology of the whole section, when the wiki gives it there and marks no part of it for an entry

etymology_unparsed.description: There is an etymology, not read into etymology_chain (prose, a wiki of no etymology configuration); absent of a placeholder of none (en {{rfe}})

etymology_prose.description: The etymology has prose of 40 words and more besides templates, links and notes (en dog, its guesses), not read into etymology_chain: for a reader of prose (a model)

notes.description: Sections of the whole language (en ===Anagrams===, pl {{źródła}}, References, See also), and sections belonging to several entries other than pronunciation, etymology and relations

media.description: Files of the language section not marked for a sense or an entry

pos.description: Part of speech, an English section name of kind pos (wiktsections.sqlite): Noun, Verb, Proper noun, Han character; null when the wiki gives none

pos_also.description: Further parts of speech of the same heading or line (de {{Wortart|Substantiv|Deutsch}}, {{n}}, {{Wortart|Toponym|Deutsch}}: pos Noun, pos_also [Toponym])

pos_written.description: The part of speech as written (''rzeczownik, rodzaj żeński'', {{S|nom|fr|num=2}}, {{-ana-|mg}})

group.description: The wiki's own number of the entry or of its group of entries: en Etymology 2, es Etimología 2, fr num=2, ru {{з|II}} (the place of the homograph when the template has no number), pl 2 of (2.1)

headword.description: Headword line or inflection template as written ({{en-noun}}, {{bn-বিশেষ্য|…}})

grammar.description: Gender, inflection class and the like as written (rodzaj żeński, de {{f}}, ''Bänke'')

etymology.description: Raw wikitext of the etymology of this entry: its own section, that of its group (en Etymology 2, a ru homograph), or the lines of the language's etymology marked for it (pl (2.1), fr {{laé|fr|nom|2}}); absent: that of the language

etymology_unparsed.description: There is an etymology, not read into etymology_chain (prose, a wiki of no etymology configuration); absent of a placeholder of none (en {{rfe}})

etymology_prose.description: The etymology has prose of 40 words and more besides templates, links and notes (en dog, its guesses), not read into etymology_chain: for a reader of prose (a model)

pronunciation.description: Raw wikitext of the pronunciation of this entry or its group (de {{Aussprache}}, en ====Pronunciation==== under ===Etymology 2===, pl {{wymowa}} lines with ids); absent: that of the language

see.description: Translations on other pages (en {{trans-see|gloss|color}}, tr {{çeviri yönlendirme}}, nl zie [[weer#Vertalingen]])

page.description: wiktlink: the page has a section of the language

subpages.description: wiktlink: translation subpages merged into the translations (en water/translations)

relations.description: Relations by the English name of a section of kind relation (wiktsections.sqlite): Synonyms, Antonyms, Hypernyms, Holonyms, Derived terms, Related terms

sections.description: Other sections of the entry (Usage notes, Inflection, Descendants)

lexeme.description: The Wikidata lexeme of the entry (ru {{Лексема в Викиданных|L110019}}); ar {{معجمية|L1480479|…}} shows its senses instead of the wiki's own

id.description: 1, 1.2 (from # and ##), or the wiki's own id: 1.1, 1a

text.description: Raw wikitext of the definition, without the examples taken out of it

examples.description: Examples and quotations of the sense: from its lines (en #:, fr #*, ru {{пример|…}}) or from an examples section by sense id (pl {{przykłady}} (1.2), de {{Beispiele}} [1])

source.description: Author, work and year of a quotation as written

sense.description: Sense id as the wiki gives it (pl (1.1), de [1, 6], ru the place of the # line, en the sense the {{syn}} template stands under)

qualifier.description: Label of the line or term as written (pl {{zdrobn}}, ru прилагательные=, en <q:archaic>)

gloss.description: The gloss of the sense of a thesaurus page the relation stands under (en {{ws sense|en|substance whose molecular formula is H₂O}})

thesaurus.description: The thesaurus page the relation comes from, merged into the entry (Thesaurus:water)

etymology_pages.description: The items of etymology_chain linked to the pages of their words: item number -> "<wiki>:<title>" ("4": "en:Reconstruction:Proto-Germanic/watōr"); of this wiki, else of the Wiktionary of the language, else of en.wiktionary

etymology_chain.description: The etymology as a text a program reads, one item a line: "n. relation language form", " [m]" when the item is of item m (a cognate of it, its descendant), else of the entry, " ?" at the end of a guess; relations from, borrowed, calque, compound (form: parts by " + "), root, compare, descendant, doublet, mention, attested (a date, no language), uncertain (of the item before it, no language, no form); read by the etymology configuration of the wiki

audio.description: Sound files of the pronunciation (pl {{audio|Pl-woda.ogg}}, en {{audio|en|En-us-water.ogg}}), files of Wikimedia Commons without the namespace

media.description: Files of Wikimedia Commons (pictures; sounds are in audio)

sense.description: Sense id of the caption (pl zamek (1.1), ru Замок [1])

lang.description: Canonical language code, null when not known

lang_written.description: Language as written, only when lang is null (not known)

sense.description: Sense id given by the wiki (pl 1.1, fr/de table number, es a1)

gloss.description: Gloss of the sense of the translation table (en {{trans-top|domestic species}})

gender.description: Gender and number marks as written: m, f, n, c, m-p, ż

image.description: The term as a picture, a file of Wikimedia Commons without the namespace (pl hieroglyphs [[Plik:Egyptian-mw.PNG|link=mw]]: term mw; signs of a sign language: term the file)

page.description: wiktlink: this wiki has a page of the term with a section of the language

en.description: wiktlink: en.wiktionary has a page of the term with a section of the language

home.description: wiktlink: the Wiktionary of the language has a page of the term with a section of the language

page_title.description: wiktlink: the title of the page found when it is not the term (without accents, optional parts)

sense_ids.description: wiktglos: ids of the senses of the entry the translation is linked to

sense_method.description: wiktglos: how the gloss was linked

sense_score.description: wiktglos: the score of the link (similarity or confidence)
